main_text.p: infimulant. Contrarium siquidem tenuisse, luce meridiana clarius est. Quid de ea Marcus Ephesius, & alij Græci Schismatici asseruerint, alibi a nobis dictum est. Illam assignauit Græcis suis Caleca. Assignauerit. Legenda erant, quæ in contrarium attulit Allatius ex Patribus, nec non etiam Schismaticis Ecclesiæ Græcæ antiquioribus, & recentioribus in Tractatu de Purgatorio, & ex aliis eiusdem Ecclesiæ Doctoribus in Hottingero. quod ut probe intelligas, nomina hic apponam. Anastasius Patriarcha Antiochenus Anagoge in Examneron Oratione 1. Andreas Cretensis Orat. in S. Nicolaum Myrhorum Lyciæ Episcopum. Andreas Hymnodus Canone in S. Nicolaum. Angelus Hymnodus Can. in S. Parasceuem. Anonymus Carmine in Mariam Romani Imperatoris coniugem. Arsenius Archiepiscopus Corcyrensis in laudatione S. Barbaræ. Auctor vitæ Cosmæ Melodi. Auctor vitæ Gregorij Decapolitæ. Auctor Commentarij de translatione reliquiarum S. Ioannis Chrysostomi. Auctor vitæ Sancti Maximi Homologetæ. Auctor vitæ S. Pachomij. Auctor laudationis S. Paulij Latrensis. Auctor laudationis S. Procopi Martyris. Auctor vitæ S. Theodori Studitæ. Basilius Imperator vniuersæ Russiæ,

page.notes: Printed text is set in roman with long s rendered as plain s throughout. "Examneron" as printed is "Examerον"-type spelling; transcribed as printed in Latin letters, but the word may read "Exameron" (the printed form looks like "Examneron"); doubtful. "Caleca" and "Hottingero" are proper names as printed. The Greek "Ancient" names are in Latin letters as printed. Printing errors left as printed: "tenuisse" (for tenuisse), "Assignauerit" as a verb ending.
